messages:
maya-eng: Quick sync — we’re doing the Dedicated capacity autopolicy + small pool resize today at 16:00 PT. No customer-facing downtime expected. Canary target: pool 'zephyr' (10 nodes) for 30m.

ken-sre: Copy. Who’s the primary deployer? I can be on standby for rollback.

maya-eng: I’ll kick it off. ken-sre you’re on rollback owner. leo-plat will monitor infra metrics. sam-qa will run smoke checks. rachel-prod will confirm traffic routing.

leo-plat: I’ll watch GPU util, scheduler latencies, and pod evictions. Alert thresholds: GPU_util > 85% for 5m or pod_restarts > 3 in 10m.

sam-qa: Smoke checklist (I’ll run after canary stabilizes):
- small end-to-end gen request (chat) 5 token, 50 token
- batch concurrency test 8 clients
- embedding batch 64

rachel-prod: FYI we’ll keep region fallback ready. Will not change routing unless we see error rate spike.

maya-eng: Canary plan:
1) Resize pool 'zephyr' + apply autoscale policy v2.1 (policy changes: lower min idle to 1, bump max to 14, faster scale-down cooldown 60s)
2) Monitor 30m, run smoke checks
3) If OK, roll to pools 'aurora' and 'polaris' in 15m intervals

maya-eng: Config snippet I’ll apply (kubectl patch):
```yaml
apiVersion: capacity.redwood/v1
kind: GPUPool
metadata:\n  name: zephyr
spec:\n  autoscalePolicy: autoscale-v2.1
  targetUtilization: 0.6
  minNodes: 1
  maxNodes: 14
```

ken-sre: Rollback command if things go sideways:
```bash
# revert to previous policy
kubectl patch gpupool zephyr -p '{"spec":{"autoscalePolicy":"autoscale-v2.0","minNodes":3,"maxNodes":10}}'
# optionally scale down/up
kubectl scale --replicas=10 gpupool/zephyr
```

leo-plat: I’ll tail the node exporter + nvml logs: `kubectl logs -l app=gpu-exporter -n infra` and watch `prometheus/rate(core_gpu_time[1m])`

sam-qa: Adding quick smoke commands:
```bash
# generation smoke
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-13b","input":"hello"}'
# embedding smoke
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"rwd-embed","input":["test"]}'
```

rachel-prod: I’ll keep routing on default. If error_rate > 1% we redirect canary to standby region. I’ll post the DNS swap steps if needed.

maya-eng: Expected risk: higher transient queueing during node spin-up. Mitigation: warm cache and increase short-term burst capacity. Keep an eye on 95p latency.

ken-sre: I’m ready on pager. Ping me in this thread with the go command.

maya-eng: Go at 16:00 PT. I’ll post the exact command here 5m before and after.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: gpupool-update-zephyr @ 2028-04-??T23:00:00Z by maya-eng :gear: (id gpupool-2028345567)

maya-eng: 15:55 PT — preparing to apply policy now. I’ll snapshot current config: `kubectl get gpupool zephyr -o yaml > /tmp/zephyr-before.yaml`

sam-qa: Ready to run smoke tests once canary shows 1 successful APM span for a gen request.

leo-plat: Noted — starting prometheus alert window at 16:00 PT.

16:00 PT

maya-eng: Applying autoscale-v2.1 to zephyr now.

deploy-bot: Job started: gpupool-2028345567 — applying patch

sam-qa: Canary gen OK (5 token) — latency 210ms, tokens per second within expected. :thumbsup:

leo-plat: GPU util jumped to 72% briefly while nodes came up, now 60%. No OOMs, no evictions.

rachel-prod: No error rate increase. 95p latency stable.

maya-eng: Rolling to aurora in 15m if no regressions.

ken-sre: All good from my side. Keeping rollback command ready.

sam-qa: Running batch concurrency test now — 8 clients, sustained 2m, results look fine.

maya-eng: After 30m canary we’ll roll. If anything looks off, we abort and revert to autoscale-v2.0.

deploy-bot: Job completed: gpupool-2028345567 — success

rachel-prod: Marking this as completed for zephyr. I’ll coordinate aurora cutover at 16:20 PT.

maya-eng: Thanks team. I’ll post follow-up with metric snapshots and the before/after gpupool YAMLs.

ken-sre: Nice and smooth. Can someone drop the runbook link here?

maya-eng: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/gpupool-autoscale (runbook + rollback steps)

sam-qa: Leaving a quick note: tested gen edge-case with long prefix — no KV-cache regressions observed.

leo-plat: Closing monitoring window in 10m. All alerts clean so far.

maya-eng: Closing thread once aurora is rolled. Thanks all. :rocket:
